label: Finding-67
title: edinburgh: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: "Late on 21 October" is looser than the source: The Scotsman says the site went down "late on Wednesday afternoon"; the Edinburgh Evening News version was published 17:24 BST with the site already down, so the outage began before about 16:24Z. "Late on 21 October" suggests the evening. | Site was back by 08:19Z on 22 Oct: The council's own homepage returned HTTP 200 with normal content at 08:19:03Z (edinburgh-council-site) and 08:19:40Z (uk-edinburgh-council). impact.json says "Website offline" with no end; the down period itself has no operator capture.
